2025-01-05.collect: O God, who wonderfully created, and yet more wonderfully restored, the dignity of human nature: Grant that we may share the divine life of him who humbled himself to share our humanity, your Son Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-01-05.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-01-05.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-01-12.collect: O God, who by the leading of a star did manifest thy only begotten Son to the Gentiles, mercifully grant that we, which know thee now by faith, may after this life see the glory of the Godhead, through Jesus Christ our Lord,
2025-01-12.hymn2: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ
2025-01-12.hymn4: 221 - Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

2025-01-19.collect: Almighty God, whose Son our Savior Jesus Christ is the light of the world: Grant that your people, illumined by your Word and Sacraments, may shine with the radiance of Christ's glory, that he may be known, worshipped, and obeyed to the ends of the earth; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who with you and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, one God, now and for ever.
2025-01-19.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-01-19.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War
2025-01-19.notes: Sanctity of Human Life | Baby Blessing

2025-01-26.collect: Give us grace, O Lord, to answer readily the call of our Savior Jesus Christ and proclaim to all people the Good News of his salvation, that we and the whole world may perceive the glory of his marvelous works; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-01-26.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-01-26.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-01-26.hymn4: 221 - Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

2025-02-02.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you govern all things both in heaven and on earth: Mercifully hear the supplications of your people, and in our time grant us your peace; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-02-02.hymn1: 304 - All People That on Earth Do Dwell
2025-02-02.hymn4: 005 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage

2025-02-09.collect: Set us free, O God, from the bondage of our sins, and give us the liberty of that abundant life which you have made known to us in your Son our Savior Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-02-09.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2025-02-09.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me

2025-02-16.collect: O God, the strength of all who put their trust in you: Mercifully accept our prayers; and because in our weakness we can do nothing good without you, give us the help of your grace, that in keeping your commandments we may please you both in will and deed; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-02-16.hymn1: 497 - Praise to the Lord, The Almighty
2025-02-16.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-02-23.collect: O Lord, you have taught us that without love whatever we do is worth nothing: Send your Holy Spirit and pour into our hearts your greatest gift, which is love, the true bond of peace and of all virtue, without which whoever lives is accounted dead before you. Grant this for the sake of your only Son Jesus Christ, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-02-23.hymn2: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ
2025-02-23.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah
2025-02-23.notes: Baptisms: Andreu Espenshied, Owen Moss, Hudson Wilson

2025-03-02.collect: O God, who before the passion of your only ­begotten Son revealed his glory upon the holy mountain: Grant to us that we, beholding by faith the light of his countenance, may be strengthened to bear our cross, and be changed into his likeness from glory to glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-03-02.hymn1: 304 - All People That on Earth Do Dwell
2025-03-02.notes: New Members: Troy & Zoe Crow | Transfiguration | Paulk Exhortation

2025-03-09.collect: Almighty God, whose blessed Son was led by the Spirit to be tempted by Satan: Come quickly to help us who are assaulted by many temptations; and, as you know the weaknesses of each of us, let each one find you mighty to save; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-03-09.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-03-09.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah
2025-03-09.notes: New Members: Reynaldo & Wendy Ortega | Talon Exhortation

2025-03-16.collect: O God, whose glory it is always to have mercy: Be gracious to all who have gone astray from your ways, and bring them again with penitent hearts and steadfast faith to embrace and hold fast the unchangeable truth of your Word, Jesus Christ your Son; who with you and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-03-16.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-03-16.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-03-23.collect: Almighty God, you know that we have no power in ourselves to help ourselves: Keep us both outwardly in our bodies and inwardly in our souls, that we may be defended from all adversities which may happen to the body, and from all evil thoughts which may assault and hurt the soul; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-03-23.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2025-03-23.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-03-23.hymn4: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2025-03-30.collect: Gracious Father, whose blessed Son Jesus Christ came down from heaven to be the true bread which gives life to the world: Evermore give us this bread, that he may live in us, and we in him; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-03-30.hymn1: 497 - Praise to the Lord, The Almighty
2025-03-30.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2025-04-06.collect: Almighty God, you alone can bring into order the unruly wills and affections of sinners: Grant your people grace to love what you command and desire what you promise; that, among the swift and varied changes of the world, our hearts may surely there be fixed where true joys are to be found; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-04-06.hymn2: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ

2025-04-13.collect: Almighty and everliving God, in your tender love for the human race you sent your Son our Savior Jesus Christ to take upon him our nature, and to suffer death upon the cross, giving us the example of his great humility: Mercifully grant that we may walk in the way of his suffering, and also share in his resurrection; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-04-13.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-04-13.hymn4: 221 - Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

2025-04-20.collect:
Almighty God, who through your only-begotten Son Jesus
Christ overcame death and opened to us the gate of
everlasting life: Grant that we, who celebrate with joy the
day of the Lord's resurrection, may be raised from the death
of sin by your life-giving Spirit; through Jesus Christ our
Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one
God, now and for ever. Amen.
2025-04-20.hymn1: 972 - Christ the Lord is Risen Today
2025-04-20.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-04-27.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, who in the Paschal mystery established the new covenant of reconciliation: Grant that all who have been reborn into the fellowship of Christ's Body may show forth in their lives what they profess by their faith; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-04-27.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-04-27.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2025-05-04.collect: O God, whose blessed Son made himself known to his disciples in the breaking of bread: Open the eyes of our faith, that we may behold him in all his redeeming work; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-05-04.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-05-04.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-05-04.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-05-11.collect: O God, whose Son Jesus is the good shepherd of your people: Grant that when we hear his voice we may know him who calls us each by name, and follow where he leads; who, with you and the Holy Spirit, lives and reigns, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-05-11.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me

2025-05-18.collect: Almighty God, whom truly to know is everlasting life: Grant us so perfectly to know your Son Jesus Christ to be the way, the truth, and the life, that we may steadfastly follow his steps in the way that leads to eternal life; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-05-18.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-05-18.hymn2: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ
2025-05-18.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-05-25.collect: O God, you have prepared for those who love you such good things as surpass our understanding: Pour into our hearts such love towards you, that we, loving you in all things and above all things, may obtain your promises, which exceed all that we can desire; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-05-25.hymn1: 304 - All People That on Earth Do Dwell

2025-06-01.collect:
O God, the King of glory, you have exalted your only Son
Jesus Christ with great triumph to your kingdom in heaven:
Do not leave us comfortless, but send us your Holy Spirit to
strengthen us, and exalt us to that place where our Savior
Christ has gone before; who lives and reigns with you and
the Holy Spirit, one God, in glory everlasting. Amen.
2025-06-01.hymn1: 972 - Christ the Lord is Risen Today
2025-06-01.hymn2: 669 - Oh, the Deep, Deep Love of Jesus
2025-06-01.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-06-08.collect:
O God, who on this day taught the hearts of your faithful
people by sending to them the light of your Holy Spirit:
Grant us by the same Spirit to have a right judgment in all
things, and evermore to rejoice in his holy comfort; through
Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with
you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and
ever. Amen.
2025-06-08.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-06-08.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2025-06-15.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you have given to us your servants grace, by the confession of a true faith, to acknowledge the glory of the eternal Trinity, and in the power of your divine Majesty to worship the Unity: Keep us steadfast in this faith and worship, and bring us at last to see you in your one and eternal glory, O Father; who with the Son and the Holy Spirit live and reign, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2025-06-15.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-06-15.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-06-22.collect: O Lord, make us have perpetual love and reverence for your holy Name, for you never fail to help and govern those whom you have set upon the sure foundation of your loving­-kindness; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-06-22.hymn1: 304 - All People That on Earth Do Dwell
2025-06-22.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)

2025-06-29.collect:
Almighty God, you have built your Church 
upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself 
being the chief cornerstone: Grant us so to be joined together in unity 
of spirit by their teaching, that we may be made a holy temple 
acceptable to you; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns 
with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2025-06-29.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-06-29.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-07-06.collect: O God, you have taught us to keep all your commandments by loving you and our neighbor: Grant us the grace of your Holy Spirit, that we may be devoted to you with our whole heart, and united to one another with pure affection; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2025-07-06.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-07-06.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-07-06.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-07-13.collect: O Lord, mercifully receive the prayers of your people who call upon you, and grant that they may know and understand what things they ought to do, and also may have grace and power faithfully to accomplish them; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-07-13.hymn4: 221 - Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

2025-07-20.collect: Almighty God, the fountain of all wisdom, you know our necessities before we ask and our ignorance in asking: Have compassion on our weakness, and mercifully give us those things which for our unworthiness we dare not, and for our blindness we cannot ask; through the worthiness of your Son Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-07-20.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me
2025-07-20.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-07-27.collect: O God, the protector of all who trust in you, without whom nothing is strong, nothing is holy: Increase and multiply upon us your mercy; that, with you as our ruler and guide, we may so pass through things temporal, that we lose not the things eternal; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-07-27.hymn2: 669 - Oh, the Deep, Deep Love of Jesus
2025-07-27.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-08-03.collect: Let your continual mercy, O Lord, cleanse and defend your Church; and, because it cannot continue in safety without your help, protect and govern it always by your goodness; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-08-03.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord

2025-08-10.collect: Grant to us, Lord, we pray, the spirit to think and do always those things that are right, that we, who cannot exist without you, may by you be enabled to live according to your will; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-08-10.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-08-10.hymn4: 679 - A Mighty Fortress is Our God

2025-08-17.collect: Almighty God, you have given your only Son to be for us a sacrifice for sin, and also an example of godly life: Give us grace to receive thankfully the fruits of his redeeming work, and to follow daily in the blessed steps of his most holy life; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-08-17.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-08-17.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-08-17.hymn4: 777 - Let Us Love, and Sing, and Wonder

2025-08-24.collect: Grant, O merciful God, that your Church, being gathered together in unity by your Holy Spirit, may show forth your power among all peoples, to the glory of your Name; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-08-24.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2025-08-24.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times
2025-08-24.hymn4: 777 - Let Us Love, and Sing, and Wonder

2025-08-31.collect: Lord of all power and might, the author and giver of all good things: Graft in our hearts the love of your Name; increase in us true religion; nourish us with all goodness; and bring forth in us the fruit of good works; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God for ever and ever.
2025-08-31.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-08-31.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-09-07.collect: Grant us, O Lord, to trust in you with all our hearts; for, as you always resist the proud who confide in their own strength, so you never forsake those who make their boast of your mercy; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-09-07.hymn4: 777 - Let Us Love, and Sing, and Wonder

2025-09-14.collect: O God, because without you we are not able to please you, mercifully grant that your Holy Spirit may in all things direct and rule our hearts; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-09-14.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-09-14.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-09-14.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-09-21.collect: Grant us, Lord, not to be anxious about earthly things, but to love things heavenly; and even now, while we are placed among things that are passing away, to hold fast to those that shall endure; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-09-21.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near

2025-09-28.collect: O God, you declare your almighty power chiefly in showing mercy and pity: Grant us the fullness of your grace, that we, running to obtain your promises, may become partakers of your heavenly treasure; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-09-28.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-09-28.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near
2025-09-28.hymn4: 725 - I Know That My Redeemer Lives

2025-10-05.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you are always more ready to hear than we to pray, and to give more than we either desire or deserve: Pour upon us the abundance of your mercy, forgiving us those things of which our conscience is afraid, and giving us those good things for which we are not worthy to ask, except through the merits and mediation of Jesus Christ our Savior; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-10-05.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-10-05.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-10-12.collect: Lord, we pray that your grace may always precede and follow us, that we may continually be given to good works; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-10-12.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near
2025-10-12.hymn4: 679 - A Mighty Fortress is Our God

2025-10-19.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, in Christ you have revealed your glory among the nations: Preserve the works of your mercy, that your Church throughout the world may persevere with steadfast faith in the confession of your Name; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-10-19.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2025-10-19.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times
2025-10-19.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-10-26.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, increase in us the gifts of faith, hope, and charity; and, that we may obtain what you promise, make us love what you command; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-10-26.hymn4: 679 - A Mighty Fortress is Our God

2025-11-02.collect: Almighty and merciful God, it is only by your gift that your faithful people offer you true and laudable service: Grant that we may run without stumbling to obtain your heavenly promises; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-11-02.hymn2: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2025-11-09.collect: O God, whose blessed Son came into the world that he might destroy the works of the devil and make us children of God and heirs of eternal life: Grant that, having this hope, we may purify ourselves as he is pure; that, when he comes again with power and great glory, we may be made like him in his eternal and glorious kingdom; where he lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-11-09.hymn1: 298 - Oh Sing a New Song to the Lord
2025-11-09.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2025-11-09.hymn4: 337 - Jehovah to My Lord Has Said

2025-11-16.collect: Blessed Lord, who caused all holy Scriptures to be written for our learning: Grant us so to hear them, read, mark, learn, and inwardly digest them, that we may embrace and ever hold fast the blessed hope of everlasting life, which you have given us in our Savior Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2025-11-16.hymn1: 304 - All People That on Earth Do Dwell
2025-11-16.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near

2025-11-23.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, whose will it is to restore all things in your well-beloved Son, the King of kings and Lord of lords: Mercifully grant that the peoples of the earth, divided and enslaved by sin, may be freed and brought together under his most gracious rule; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-11-23.hymn1: 975 - Now Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2025-11-23.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2025-11-23.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2025-11-30.collect: Almighty God, give us grace to cast away the works of darkness, and put on the armor of light, now in the time of this mortal life in which your Son Jesus Christ came to visit us in great humility; that in the last day, when he shall come again in his glorious majesty to judge both the living and the dead, we may rise to the life immortal; through him who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2025-12-07.collect: Merciful God, who sent your messengers the prophets to preach repentance and prepare the way for our salvation: Give us grace to heed their warnings and forsake our sins, that we may greet with joy the coming of Jesus Christ our Redeemer; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2025-12-07.hymn1: 920 - Angels From the Realms of Glory

2025-12-14.collect: Stir up your power, O Lord, and with great might come among us; and, because we are sorely hindered by our sins, let your bountiful grace and mercy speedily help and deliver us; through Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom, with you and the Holy Spirit, be honor and glory, now and for ever.
2025-12-14.hymn1: 892 - Angels We Have Heard On High
2025-12-14.hymn4: 866 - The Lord At First Did Adam Make

2025-12-21.collect: Purify our conscience, Almighty God, by your daily visitation, that your Son Jesus Christ, at his coming, may find in us a mansion prepared for himself; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2025-12-28.collect:
Almighty God, you have poured upon us the new light of
your incarna
2025-12-28.hymn1: 897 - Joy to the World! The Lord Is Come

2026-01-04.collect: O God, who wonderfully created, and yet more wonderfully restored, the dignity of human nature: Grant that we may share the divine life of him who humbled himself to share our humanity, your Son Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-01-04.hymn1: 920 - Angels from the Realms of Glory
2026-01-04.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2026-01-11.collect: O God, who by the leading of a star did manifest thy only begotten Son to the Gentiles, mercifully grant that we, which know thee now by faith, may after this life see the glory of the Godhead, through Jesus Christ our Lord,
2026-01-11.hymn1: 221 - Jesus Shall Reign Where'r the Sun
2026-01-11.hymn2: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage (Psalm 2)
2026-01-11.hymn4: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ

2026-01-18.collect: Almighty God, whose Son our Savior Jesus Christ is the light of the world: Grant that your people, illumined by your Word and Sacraments, may shine with the radiance of Christ's glory, that he may be known, worshipped, and obeyed to the ends of the earth; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who with you and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, one God, now and for ever.
2026-01-18.hymn1: 298 - Oh, Sing a New Song to the LORD (Psalm 98)

2026-01-25.collect: Give us grace, O Lord, to answer readily the call of our Savior Jesus Christ and proclaim to all people the Good News of his salvation, that we and the whole world may perceive the glory of his marvelous works; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-01-25.hymn4: 460 - All Praise Be to the LORD My Rock (Psalm 144)

2026-02-01.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you govern all things both in heaven and on earth: Mercifully hear the supplications of your people, and in our time grant us your peace; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-02-01.hymn1: 975 - Now, Let the Vault of Heaven Resound
2026-02-01.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near
2026-02-01.hymn4: 460 - All Praise Be to the LORD My Rock (Psalm 144)

2026-02-08.collect: Set us free, O God, from the bondage of our sins, and give us the liberty of that abundant life which you have made known to us in your Son our Savior Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2026-02-08.hymn1: 777 - Let Us Love and Sing and Wonder

2026-02-15.collect: O God, the strength of all who put their trust in you: Mercifully accept our prayers; and because in our weakness we can do nothing good without you, give us the help of your grace, that in keeping your commandments we may please you both in will and deed; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-02-15.hymn1: 304 - All People That On Earth Do Dwell (Psalm 100)
2026-02-15.hymn2: 1028 - Blest Be the Tie That Binds
2026-02-15.hymn4: 460 - All Praise Be to the LORD My Rock (Psalm 144)

2026-02-22.collect: Almighty God, whose blessed Son was led by the Spirit to be tempted by Satan: Come quickly to help us who are assaulted by many temptations; and, as you know the weaknesses of each of us, let each one find you mighty to save; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2026-02-22.hymn1: 298 - Oh, Sing a New Song to the LORD (Psalm 98)
2026-02-22.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near

2026-03-01.collect: O God, whose glory it is always to have mercy: Be gracious to all who have gone astray from your ways, and bring them again with penitent hearts and steadfast faith to embrace and hold fast the unchangeable truth of your Word, Jesus Christ your Son; who with you and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-03-01.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2026-03-08.collect: Almighty God, you know that we have no power in ourselves to help ourselves: Keep us both outwardly in our bodies and inwardly in our souls, that we may be defended from all adversities which may happen to the body, and from all evil thoughts which may assault and hurt the soul; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-03-08.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar

2026-03-15.collect: Gracious Father, whose blessed Son Jesus Christ came down from heaven to be the true bread which gives life to the world: Evermore give us this bread, that he may live in us, and we in him; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-03-22.collect: Almighty God, you alone can bring into order the unruly wills and affections of sinners: Grant your people grace to love what you command and desire what you promise; that, among the swift and varied changes of the world, our hearts may surely there be fixed where true joys are to be found; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-03-29.collect: Almighty and everliving God, in your tender love for the human race you sent your Son our Savior Jesus Christ to take upon him our nature, and to suffer death upon the cross, giving us the example of his great humility: Mercifully grant that we may walk in the way of his suffering, and also share in his resurrection; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-03-29.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me
2026-03-29.hymn4: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2026-04-05.collect:
O God, who for our redemption gave your only-begotten
Son to the death of the cross, and by his glorious resurrection
delivered us from the power of our enemy: Grant us so to die
daily to sin, that we may evermore live with him in the joy of
his resurrection; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord,
who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God,
now and for ever. Amen.
2026-04-05.hymn1: 972 - Christ, the Lord, is Risen Today
2026-04-05.hymn4: 725 - I Know That My Redeemer Lives

2026-04-12.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, who in the Paschal mystery established the new covenant of reconciliation: Grant that all who have been reborn into the fellowship of Christ's Body may show forth in their lives what they profess by their faith; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-04-12.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2026-04-12.hymn4: 580 - Thy Works, Not Mine, O Christ

2026-04-19.collect: O God, whose blessed Son made himself known to his disciples in the breaking of bread: Open the eyes of our faith, that we may behold him in all his redeeming work; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2026-04-19.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times

2026-04-26.collect: O God, whose Son Jesus is the good shepherd of your people: Grant that when we hear his voice we may know him who calls us each by name, and follow where he leads; who, with you and the Holy Spirit, lives and reigns, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-04-26.hymn1: 972 - Christ, the Lord, is Risen Today
2026-04-26.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar

2026-05-03.collect: Almighty God, whom truly to know is everlasting life: Grant us so perfectly to know your Son Jesus Christ to be the way, the truth, and the life, that we may steadfastly follow his steps in the way that leads to eternal life; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-05-03.hymn1: 298 - Oh, Sing a New Song to the LORD (Psalm 98)
2026-05-03.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me
2026-05-03.hymn4: 460 - All Praise Be to the LORD My Rock (Psalm 144)

2026-05-10.collect: O God, you have prepared for those who love you such good things as surpass our understanding: Pour into our hearts such love towards you, that we, loving you in all things and above all things, may obtain your promises, which exceed all that we can desire; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-05-10.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near
2026-05-10.hymn4: 1023 - The Son of God Goes Forth to War

2026-05-17.collect:
Almighty God, whose blessed Son our Savior Jesus Christ
ascended far above all heavens that he might fill all things:
Mercifully give us faith to perceive that, according to his
promise, he abides with his Church on earth, even to the end
of the ages; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and
reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, in glory
everlasting. Amen.
2026-05-17.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2026-05-17.hymn4: 1001 - Hail the Day That Sees Him Rise

2026-05-24.collect: Almighty God, on this day you opened the way of eternal life to every race and nation by the promised gift of your Holy Spirit: Shed abroad this gift throughout the world by the preaching of the Gospel, that it may reach to the ends of the earth; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2026-05-24.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2026-05-24.hymn2: 1028 - Blest Be the Tie That Binds
2026-05-24.hymn4: 685 - My Hope is Built on Nothing Less
2026-05-24.notes: New Members: Webbs & Gardners | Baptisms: Lydia & Kimber Webb | Pentecost

2026-05-31.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you have given to us your servants grace, by the confession of a true faith, to acknowledge the glory of the eternal Trinity, and in the power of your divine Majesty to worship the Unity: Keep us steadfast in this faith and worship, and bring us at last to see you in your one and eternal glory, O Father; who with the Son and the Holy Spirit live and reign, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2026-05-31.hymn4: 211 - Let God Arise in All His Might
2026-05-31.sermonText: 10:34-42 | A Sword, a Cross, and a Crown

2026-06-07.collect: O God, from whom all good proceeds: Grant that by your inspiration we may think those things that are right, and by your merciful guiding may do them; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2026-06-07.hymn4: 5 - Why Do the Heathen Nations Vainly Rage?

2026-06-14.collect: Keep, O Lord, your household the Church in your steadfast faith and love, that through your grace we may proclaim your truth with boldness, and minister your justice with compassion; for the sake of our Savior Jesus Christ, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever. Amen.
2026-06-14.hymn1: 298 - Oh, Sing a New Song to the LORD (Psalm 98)
2026-06-14.hymn2: 71 - Be Not Far Off for Grief is Near

2026-06-21.collect: O Lord, make us have perpetual love and reverence for your holy Name, for you never fail to help and govern those whom you have set upon the sure foundation of your loving­-kindness; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-06-21.hymn1: 777 - Let Us Love and Sing and Wonder
2026-06-21.hymn2: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah
2026-06-21.hymn4: 211 - Let God Arise in All His Might

2026-06-28.collect:
Almighty God, you have built your Church 
upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself 
being the chief cornerstone: Grant us so to be joined together in unity 
of spirit by their teaching, that we may be made a holy temple 
acceptable to you; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns 
with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2026-06-28.hymn2: 629 - Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me

2026-07-05.collect: O God, you have taught us to keep all your commandments by loving you and our neighbor: Grant us the grace of your Holy Spirit, that we may be devoted to you with our whole heart, and united to one another with pure affection; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen.
2026-07-05.hymn1: 304 - All People That On Earth Do Dwell (Psalm 100)

2026-07-12.collect: O Lord, mercifully receive the prayers of your people who call upon you, and grant that they may know and understand what things they ought to do, and also may have grace and power faithfully to accomplish them; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2026-07-12.hymn2: 61 - The LORD Hear Thee in Troubled Times
2026-07-12.hymn4: 460 - All Praise Be to the LORD My Rock (Psalm 144)

2026-07-19.collect: Almighty God, the fountain of all wisdom, you know our necessities before we ask and our ignorance in asking: Have compassion on our weakness, and mercifully give us those things which for our unworthiness we dare not, and for our blindness we cannot ask; through the worthiness of your Son Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.
2026-07-19.hymn1: 298 - Oh, Sing a New Song to the LORD (Psalm 98)
2026-07-19.hymn2: 596 - O God of Earth and Altar
2026-07-19.hymn4: 725 - I Know That My Redeemer Lives

2026-07-26.collect: O God, the protector of all who trust in you, without whom nothing is strong, nothing is holy: Increase and multiply upon us your mercy; that, with you as our ruler and guide, we may so pass through things temporal, that we lose not the things eternal; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-07-26.hymn1: 518 - All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
2026-07-26.hymn2: 1028 - Blest Be the Tie That Binds
2026-07-26.hymn4: 410 - Blest the Man That Fears Jehovah

2026-08-02.collect: Let your continual mercy, O Lord, cleanse and defend your Church; and, because it cannot continue in safety without your help, protect and govern it always by your goodness; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-08-09.collect: Grant to us, Lord, we pray, the spirit to think and do always those things that are right, that we, who cannot exist without you, may by you be enabled to live according to your will; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-08-16.collect: Almighty God, you have given your only Son to be for us a sacrifice for sin, and also an example of godly life: Give us grace to receive thankfully the fruits of his redeeming work, and to follow daily in the blessed steps of his most holy life; through Jesus Christ your Son our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-08-23.collect: Grant, O merciful God, that your Church, being gathered together in unity by your Holy Spirit, may show forth your power among all peoples, to the glory of your Name; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-08-30.collect: Lord of all power and might, the author and giver of all good things: Graft in our hearts the love of your Name; increase in us true religion; nourish us with all goodness; and bring forth in us the fruit of good works; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God for ever and ever.

2026-09-06.collect: Grant us, O Lord, to trust in you with all our hearts; for, as you always resist the proud who confide in their own strength, so you never forsake those who make their boast of your mercy; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-09-13.collect: O God, because without you we are not able to please you, mercifully grant that your Holy Spirit may in all things direct and rule our hearts; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-09-20.collect: Grant us, Lord, not to be anxious about earthly things, but to love things heavenly; and even now, while we are placed among things that are passing away, to hold fast to those that shall endure; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-09-27.collect: O God, you declare your almighty power chiefly in showing mercy and pity: Grant us the fullness of your grace, that we, running to obtain your promises, may become partakers of your heavenly treasure; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-10-04.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, you are always more ready to hear than we to pray, and to give more than we either desire or deserve: Pour upon us the abundance of your mercy, forgiving us those things of which our conscience is afraid, and giving us those good things for which we are not worthy to ask, except through the merits and mediation of Jesus Christ our Savior; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-10-11.collect: Lord, we pray that your grace may always precede and follow us, that we may continually be given to good works; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-10-18.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, in Christ you have revealed your glory among the nations: Preserve the works of your mercy, that your Church throughout the world may persevere with steadfast faith in the confession of your Name; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-10-25.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, increase in us the gifts of faith, hope, and charity; and, that we may obtain what you promise, make us love what you command; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
2026-10-25.sermonText: Get Back in the Cage Stage

2026-11-01.collect: Almighty and merciful God, it is only by your gift that your faithful people offer you true and laudable service: Grant that we may run without stumbling to obtain your heavenly promises; through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-11-08.collect: O God, whose blessed Son came into the world that he might destroy the works of the devil and make us children of God and heirs of eternal life: Grant that, having this hope, we may purify ourselves as he is pure; that, when he comes again with power and great glory, we may be made like him in his eternal and glorious kingdom; where he lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-11-15.collect: Blessed Lord, who caused all holy Scriptures to be written for our learning: Grant us so to hear them, read, mark, learn, and inwardly digest them, that we may embrace and ever hold fast the blessed hope of everlasting life, which you have given us in our Savior Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.

2026-11-22.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, whose will it is to restore all things in your well-beloved Son, the King of kings and Lord of lords: Mercifully grant that the peoples of the earth, divided and enslaved by sin, may be freed and brought together under his most gracious rule; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-11-29.collect: Almighty God, give us grace to cast away the works of darkness, and put on the armor of light, now in the time of this mortal life in which your Son Jesus Christ came to visit us in great humility; that in the last day, when he shall come again in his glorious majesty to judge both the living and the dead, we may rise to the life immortal; through him who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-12-06.collect: Merciful God, who sent your messengers the prophets to preach repentance and prepare the way for our salvation: Give us grace to heed their warnings and forsake our sins, that we may greet with joy the coming of Jesus Christ our Redeemer; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-12-13.collect: Stir up your power, O Lord, and with great might come among us; and, because we are sorely hindered by our sins, let your bountiful grace and mercy speedily help and deliver us; through Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom, with you and the Holy Spirit, be honor and glory, now and for ever.

2026-12-20.collect: Purify our conscience, Almighty God, by your daily visitation, that your Son Jesus Christ, at his coming, may find in us a mansion prepared for himself; who lives and reigns with you, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever.

2026-12-27.collect:
Almighty God, you have poured upon us the new light of
your incarna
